# Security

Report a vulnerability privately to Pato / Canzeco. Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Canzeco/mesita-monorepo/security/advisories/new) on this repository, or email security@mesita.ai. Do not open a public issue or pull request. There is no bug bounty.

Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and what you could reach. You will get a reply within three business days.

In scope: the apps under `apps/`, the Edge Functions under `supabase/`, and the live hosts [mesita.ai](https://mesita.ai), [consumer.mesita.ai](https://consumer.mesita.ai), [business.mesita.ai](https://business.mesita.ai), [admin.mesita.ai](https://admin.mesita.ai) and [check.mesita.ai](https://check.mesita.ai). Do not test against accounts that are not yours, and do not access data that is not yours.
